description: Governed authored COMPLEXITY band of an element or scene — a design-time judgment of how much cognitive load the content carries. Promoted from the layout engine's Script_Normalizer `complexity_level` axis. This is a DESIGN-TIME content property (set once by the author/generator), distinct from `audience.difficulty`, which is a continuous 0..1 per-learner targeting knob the responsive engine tunes. Complexity is READ by the realizer to inform layout selection (e.g. high-complexity content favors reveal/segmented layouts over a single dense body).

governance.rule: Elements may only use ids defined here. A new value requires a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else.
governance.supplants: The inline `complexity_level` enum in layout-engine intent_sidecar.schema.json (retired in favor of this governed list).

field: element.audience.complexity (proposed small addition to element.schema.json). Complements, does not replace, audience.difficulty.

values.label: Low
values.definition: Single idea or a small set of peers; low cognitive load.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Several related ideas or a short process; moderate load.

values.label: High
values.definition: Many interacting ideas, conditionals, or a dense model; high load — segment or stage it.
